note: Schema follows the art brief's Section 37 spec. 'implemented' entries are real, working Tween/_process animations in the current build (grep the file_path to see them run); 'planned' entries are required by the brief but have no code yet - grouped by category rather than fabricated frame-by-frame detail that doesn't exist.

animations.frames_or_bones: n/a (scale tween on the whole node)
animations.interrupt_rules: a new tween on the same node kills the previous one (Godot Tween default)

animations.trigger: player attempts an invalid merge (mismatched chain, producer, max level)

animations.frames_or_bones: n/a (procedural circle-ring particles drawn in _draw(), not a sprite sheet)
animations.required_particle: generic expanding-ring burst - brief section 9 asks for chain-themed particles (wood splinters, sparks, fabric fibres, etc.) instead of one generic effect; not yet implemented per-chain
animations.interrupt_rules: one-shot, self-frees on completion (queue_free after tween)
animations.mobile_performance_cost: low - one Control per burst, freed immediately after
animations.status: implemented, generic (not yet chain-themed - see brief section 9)

animations.required_particle: procedural dust-burst dots, not a themed particle set
animations.trigger: a residence hotspot's quest completes (any residence - Hollow Creek and Redwater both call this)
always running while the marker is visible on the World Map
animations.mobile_performance_cost: negligible per marker; scales with marker count (currently at most ~7 markers on screen)

animations.interrupt_rules: a new toast while one is showing kills and restarts the tween

animations.trigger: always running on the main menu
animations.mobile_performance_cost: low - one _process callback, no allocations per frame

animations.interrupt_rules: _is_transitioning guard blocks overlapping transitions; duration is 0 when GameManager.settings.reduced_motion is set
animations.mobile_performance_cost: negligible - one full-screen ColorRect, already in the scene tree permanently

animations.frames_or_bones: n/a (modulate:a fade in -> hold -> fade out)
animations.interrupt_rules: tap/click anywhere kills the tween and advances immediately
